## Details

<a id="part_dest_ptrs"></a>
### [`part_dest_ptrs`](../../../../src/sprites/part_layout.asm#L6) `$CD4C-$CD5D`

*data*

Address of each of the 9 sprite parts in the fighter buffer at $05ca. The buffer has 3 x 3 parts, 9 bytes for each line.

- **Read by:** [`build_pose_image`](../fighter/pose_image.md#build_pose_image)

<a id="part_byte_offsets"></a>
### [`part_byte_offsets`](../../../../src/sprites/part_layout.asm#L11) `$CD5E-$CD9C`

*data*

Offset in the fighter buffer of each of the 63 bytes of a sprite part.

- **Read by:** [`build_pose_image`](../fighter/pose_image.md#build_pose_image)

<a id="buffer_column_offsets"></a>
### [`buffer_column_offsets`](../../../../src/sprites/part_layout.asm#L22) `$CD9D-$CDA5`

*data*

Offset in the work bitmap of each byte of a fighter buffer line, from the last byte to the first. Each byte fills one cell column.

- **Read by:** [`draw_fighter`](../fighter/draw.md#draw_fighter)

<a id="work_row_offsets"></a>
### [`work_row_offsets`](../../../../src/sprites/part_layout.asm#L26) `$CDA6-$CDB5`

*data*

Offset of character rows 0-7 in the work bitmap (320 bytes each).

- **Read by:** [`draw_fighter`](../fighter/draw.md#draw_fighter)
